text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black claims 1st place in the 
Osaka Hai. Satono Diamond falls short and 
suffers defeat.

In the stands, Mejiro McQueen and Tokai 
Teio were also watching the race unfold.

Satono Diamond felt that Kitasan Black had 
grown dramatically stronger.

However, fired up with determination not 
to lose next time, Satono Diamond and her 
rival promised to have a rematch at the 
Tenno Sho (Spring).
